name: Might & Mushroom
description:
About This Game

Curate Your Own Shop Pool! Break Free from RNG Frustration!!

Treat your shop like a deck! Throughout your adventure, you can acquire new Shroom Spores to shuffle into your shop pool, or banish the ones you don't need. Will you thin out your pool to easily roll 3 star units, or expand it to trigger massive synergies? Your strategy, your call!

Re-rolling is a Tactical Weapon! A Game Changing Turning Point!

Units of the same Class and Faction share powerful Resonance effects. Every time you re-roll, you might trigger these Resonances directly from your hand, buffing your entire board! In critical moments, a well-timed re-roll isn't just about building your lineup; it can instantly detonate the battlefield. Even if you miss your key units, Resonances can massively boost your combat power!

Master the Art of Positioning! Experience Pure Strategic Charm.

During the preparation phase, deploy your "Shroom-roes" onto the board. But be careful! Your layout doesn't just dictate your buffs; it determines the entire flow of attack and defense! You need to maximize your advantages through clever positioning and deploy units that counter the enemy's lineup. Once the battle begins, sit back and watch your mushroom army automatically unleash their skills and wreak havoc based on your setup!

Meet Dozens of Multiverse Heroes, All Sporting Mushroom Caps!

From the Frost-spore-wielding "Lich Shroom" to brilliant tactical masterminds, every Shroom-roe comes with unique skills and hilarious fungal designs. But don't let their cute looks fool you, their power is immense! Mix and match different Factions and Classes to discover thousands of crazy, out-of-the-box builds!

Your adventures will never be the same, with massive amounts of content waiting to be unlocked:

  • 50+ Unique Mushroom Units

  • 2 Distinct Evolutionary Paths for units

  • 200+ Game Changing Relics

  • 100+ Tide Turning Spell Cards

  • 10,000+ Procedurally Generated Adventure Paths

  • And even more surprises waiting for you!

The Dungeon Lord's tyranny has raged for too long. Must the mushrooms tremble in the dark forever? NO! Grip the reality-bending Mushroom Pocket, summon brave Shroom-roes from across the multiverse, and forge an unstoppable mushroom army! March into the deepest depths of the dungeon, this isn't just an expedition; it's a testament to your courage and the epic saga of mushrooms defying their fate!
short_desc: Draft your own shop in this deckbuilding roguelike auto battler! Summon fungal versions of legendary heroes, and take control of your fate with a unique shop building system and innovative synergy mechanics! Revolution is brewing, let's turn that evil dragon into mushroom soup!
